method: Local TestClient, 166 shaped personas (+fixture personas), fake source-ingest owner with newest-first pages, 3000 evidence items, 0.2 s per owner request (slow) or unavailable after 0.2 s. 5 runs per cell. Harness: services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_quarterly_ranking_read_latency.py helpers.
root_cause: _pm12_public_quarter_evidence_refs called read_evidence_refs() with no page_size, so the port streamed every owner evidence page (EVIDENCE_OWNER_PAGE_SIZE=200) before filtering to the quarter. Cost grew linearly with total owner evidence; on hosted each owner request waits ~4 s.
fix: personas/service.py: the quarter evidence read passes page_size=_PM12_QUARTER_EVIDENCE_PAGE_SIZE (500, the owner endpoint maximum) so exactly one owner request is made. The context is composed once per request (_compose_quarterly_ranking_context), so ranking, recommendations and drilldown each pay the owner wait at most once. No cache, setting, endpoint or job added; ports/research_knowledge_source.py unchanged (its existing page_size path is used).

profile_ms_before_after.cprofile_after_quarterly_ranking_s: total 0.9 under profiler: owner wait 0.2, rankings/snapshots.py snapshot digest 0.28, remainder ASGI/serialisation. No remaining stream-proportional cost.

notes: persona-league/tiers makes no evidence-owner request locally (0 owner calls, p50 ~0.06 s); its hosted 5-9 s is not reproduced by this profile and is not changed by this task. Not claimed as fixed.
Unavailable owner: first page fails, so the wait was already paid once before; unchanged by design, now also true for slow owners.

Behavior bound: only the newest 500 owner evidence items are considered for the quarter. Output is identical to the old full stream whenever the owner holds <=500 items (tested with 300); with more, quarter evidence older than the newest 500 owner items is no longer attached. Owner has no time-range filter and adding one is out of scope (no new endpoint).

tests.added: services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_quarterly_ranking_read_latency.py (9 tests): owner requests == 1 for 50/5000/50000 evidence on ranking, recommendations, drilldown; unavailable owner paid once; full payload (items, order, scores, ranking_snapshot_id, evidence and surface status) equals the unbounded-stream output for 166 personas, volatile timestamps/correlation ids stripped.
tests.assertions_changed: none; no existing test weakened or deleted.
